notifications.name: Sensory Blocks Set of 16
notifications.danger: The toy could rupture and the filling of the inside could come out. The sand inside contains asbestos (measured value up to 1.92% by weight). Asbestos could cause cancer. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): DistributorCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: Set of 16 wooden sensory sand-filled toys, including triangles, rectangles, squares, and semicircular pieces made of natural wood and filled with coloured sand, liquid, and small beads in red, blue, green, yellow, and clear sections.

notifications.name: USB-C 20W Power Adapter
notifications.danger: The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The secondary USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.

notifications.name: IONIQ6 (CE)
notifications.danger: The front seatbelt snap-on anchor may become misaligned or come loose. This could impair the seatbelt’s restraining function in the event of a collision, increasing the risk of injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
